ED_Title: Notification by the Secretary-General under Article 12, paragraph 2, of the Charter of the United Nations
ED_DecisionText: At its 89th plenary meeting, on 5 June 2026, the General Assembly took note of the note of the Secretary-General. (Footnote: A/80/300.)
ED_Disclaimer: The final text of this decision will be contained in document A/80/49 (Vol. III) after editorial review.
